key_provisions_or_claims: Trading robots execute trades automatically based on pre-programmed algorithms.
Legal consequences for capital and commodity futures market players are currently regulated in Bappebti Regulation No. 12 of 2022.
Uses normative juridical method with a statutory approach.
Context includes illegal trading-robot investment schemes causing large losses to victims.
named_instruments_referenced: Indonesia Capital Market Law No. 8 of 1995
annotation.summary_en: Undergraduate thesis preprint analysing the legal consequences of using software trading robots for Indonesian capital market and commodity futures players, using a normative juridical statutory approach. It concludes the matter is currently governed by Bappebti Regulation No. 12 of 2022.
annotation.title_clean: Legal Consequences of Using Trading Robots for Capital Market and Commodity Futures Market Players
annotation.title_en: Legal Consequences of Using Trading Robots for Capital Market and Commodity Futures Market Players
